headline: SDP @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.45 at CHC 4.61, with a projected total of 9.06. Movement read: NRFI probability rose +18.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shota Imanaga has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Miguel Andujar, Rodolfo Durán because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
